messages.content:
You are an expert antenna engineer and HFSS scripting assistant.
Your goal is to design an antenna in Ansys HFSS that satisfies the following requirements:

设计一个中心频率 2.45 GHz 的微带贴片天线，S11 < -10 dB，-10 dB 带宽 > 100 MHz，峰值增益 > 3 dBi。

You can interact with HFSS through the provided tools. At each step, decide which tool(s) to call.
After each tool call, you will receive the result/observation from HFSS.
Design iteratively: adjust geometry/material/variables, solve, read results, and refine.
When you are satisfied with the design, call `finalize_design` with a short summary and the final metrics.

Environment (read carefully — most mistakes happen here):
- `update_geometry` executes a Python snippet via PyAEDT. A variable `hfss` is in scope:
  an `ansys.aedt.core.Hfss` object already connected to your project.
  Use the PyAEDT API, e.g.:
    hfss.modeler.create_box(origin=["-W/2", "-L/2", "0mm"], sizes=["W", "L", "1.6mm"], name="Substrate", material="FR4_epoxy")
    hfss.create_setup("Setup1")
  Do NOT use the AEDT record-script style (oEditor.CreateRectangle / oDesign...) — it will fail.
- When creating ports, pass integration_line endpoints as literal numeric
  coordinates (e.g. ["0mm", "-47.5mm", "0mm"]), not variable expressions;
  expression strings are not reliably evaluated in this API context.
  If the wave port fails, prefer hfss.lumped_port(...) — for a microstrip
  feed it is more forgiving and sufficient for S11 extraction.
- Fixed naming convention (do not invent other names):
  solution setup: "Setup1"; frequency sweep: "Sweep1"; wave port: "Port1".
  When reading results use solution name "Setup1 : Sweep1" and expression dB(S(1,1)).
- To read gain / radiation efficiency, call `get_result` with a report name mentioning
  gain or efficiency (e.g. "Gain Plot"); the result returns peak_gain_dbi and
  radiation_efficiency_percent.
- `solve` calls are budget-limited. Every tool result reports `remaining_solve_calls`;
  plan your iterations so you stay within budget.
- Call `export_design` to save the project before `finalize_design`.

Rules:
1. Always use SI units or specify units explicitly (e.g. "28.5mm", "2.45GHz").
2. Keep changes minimal and explain why you make each change.
3. If a simulation or script fails, read the error message in the tool result and fix the issue.
4. Do not invent values that you can read from HFSS; prefer using `get_result`.
5. After finalize_design, no more tool calls are allowed.
6. In update_geometry scripts, do NOT wrap critical steps (port/boundary/setup/sweep
   creation) in try/except that only prints and continues. If a critical step fails,
   let the exception raise so the tool reports failure. Your print() output IS
   returned to you — check it for warnings before assuming success.
7. Before calling solve, make sure the design has: at least one excitation port,
   a radiation boundary (or open region), and Setup1 with Sweep1. Solving a design
   without any port is a fatal error in HFSS.

Please design an antenna satisfying these requirements:
设计一个中心频率 2.45 GHz 的微带贴片天线，S11 < -10 dB，-10 dB 带宽 > 100 MHz，峰值增益 > 3 dBi。

Start by creating geometry/variables. Report back each step using tools.
Step 1: 我先建立贴片天线的初始参数变量。选择低损耗、较厚的 Rogers 5880 类基板以提高带宽；初始尺寸按 2.45 GHz 矩形贴片公式估算，并采用 inset-fed 微带馈电以便匹配到 50 Ω。
Step 2: 下面创建 HFSS 几何、材料、PEC 金属片、lumped port、空气盒辐射边界以及 Setup1/Sweep1。初始设计为中心馈电 inset 贴片：通过调节 `inset_d` 控制输入阻抗，通过 `patch_l` 控制谐振频率。

function.name: update_geometry
function.arguments:
{"script": "import math

# Use mm as model unit
hfss.modeler.model_units = "mm"

# Clean up existing objects if rerun
existing = [obj.name for obj in hfss.modeler.objects]
if existing:
    hfss.modeler.delete(existing)

# Remove existing setups if present
try:
    for s in list(hfss.setups):
        hfss.delete_setup(s.name)
except Exception:
    pass

# Add low-loss substrate material for wider bandwidth and good gain
mat_name = "Rogers5880_custom"
if mat_name not in hfss.materials.material_keys:
    mat = hfss.materials.add_material(mat_name)
else:
    mat = hfss.materials[mat_name]
mat.permittivity = 2.2
mat.dielectric_loss_tangent = 0.0009

# Substrate and finite ground plane
sub = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    origin=["-sub_w/2", "-sub_l/2", "0mm"],
    sizes=["sub_w", "sub_l", "sub_h"],
    name="Substrate",
    material=mat_name
)

gnd = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(
    orientation="XY",
    origin=["-sub_w/2", "-sub_l/2", "0mm"],
    sizes=["sub_w", "sub_l"],
    name="Ground",
    material="copper"
)

# Inset-fed patch metallization at z = sub_h, split into simple touching rectangles.
# This creates two inset slots beside the center feed line.
top = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(
    orientation="XY",
    origin=["-patch_w/2", "-patch_l/2+inset_d", "sub_h"],
    sizes=["patch_w", "patch_l-inset_d"],
    name="Patch_top",
    material="copper"
)
left = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(
    orientation="XY",
    origin=["-patch_w/2", "-patch_l/2", "sub_h"],
    sizes=["(patch_w-feed_w)/2-notch_gap", "inset_d"],
    name="Patch_left_inset_arm",
    material="copper"
)
right = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(
    orientation="XY",
    origin=["feed_w/2+notch_gap", "-patch_l/2", "sub_h"],
    sizes=["(patch_w-feed_w)/2-notch_gap", "inset_d"],
    name="Patch_right_inset_arm",
    material="copper"
)
feed = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(
    orientation="XY",
    origin=["-feed_w/2", "-sub_l/2", "sub_h"],
    sizes=["feed_w", "sub_l/2-patch_l/2+inset_d"],
    name="FeedLine",
    material="copper"
)

# Assign PEC to all metal sheets for a clean first-pass antenna model
hfss.assign_perfecte_to_sheets([gnd.name, top.name, left.name, right.name, feed.name], name="PEC_Metals", is_infinite_gnd=False)

# Lumped port sheet at the microstrip feed input edge, numeric endpoints per API constraint
port_sheet = hfss.modeler.create_rectangle(
    orientation="XZ",
    origin=["-4.8mm", "-50mm", "0mm"],
    sizes=["9.6mm", "3.175mm"],
    name="Port1_sheet",
    material="vacuum"
)
hfss.lumped_port(
    assignment=port_sheet.name,
    integration_line=[["0mm", "-50mm", "0mm"], ["0mm", "-50mm", "3.175mm"]],
    impedance=50,
    name="Port1",
    renormalize=True
)

# Radiation air box; keep at least ~lambda/4 clearance above the patch at 2.45 GHz
air = hfss.modeler.create_box(
    origin=["-sub_w/2-air_margin", "-sub_l/2-air_margin", "-air_below"],
    sizes=["sub_w+2*air_margin", "sub_l+2*air_margin", "sub_h+air_above+air_below"],
    name="AirBox",
    material="air"
)
hfss.assign_radiation_boundary_to_objects(air.name, boundary_name="Rad1")

# Far-field sphere for gain/efficiency extraction
hfss.insert_infinite_sphere(name="Infinite Sphere1", x_start=0, x_stop=180, x_step=5, y_start=0, y_stop=360, y_step=5)

# Driven solution setup and frequency sweep
setup = hfss.create_setup(name="Setup1")
setup.props["Frequency"] = "2.45GHz"
setup.props["MaxDeltaS"] = 0.02
setup.props["MaximumPasses"] = 12
setup.props["MinimumPasses"] = 2
setup.props["MinimumConvergedPasses"] = 1
setup.update()

hfss.create_linear_count_sweep(
    setup="Setup1",
    units="GHz",
    start_frequency=2.2,
    stop_frequency=2.7,
    num_of_freq_points=251,
    name="Sweep1",
    sweep_type="Interpolating",
    save_fields=False,
    save_rad_fields=True
)

print("Created inset-fed 2.45 GHz microstrip patch on Rogers5880_custom.")
print("Initial dimensions: patch_w=48.5mm, patch_l=39.0mm, sub_h=3.175mm, feed_w=9.6mm, inset_d=13.5mm.")
print("Excitation Port1, radiation boundary Rad1, Setup1 and Sweep1 are defined.")"}
